spec.text: Image 1 is the man's character model sheet; image 2 is the woman's character model sheet; image 3 is a real photo of the theatre during that show; image 4 is the same stage already drawn in the approved style; image 5 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). Inside PLAYground Nancun Theater during the musical 'I Love You, You're Perfect, Now Change': the small intimate venue from images 3 and 4, a low wooden stage with a red back wall, warm string lights draped under an exposed white mesh roof with black stage lights, empty wooden frames and clothing racks as the set, round cafe tables and wooden chairs for the audience. Seen from behind, the woman and the man sit side by side at a small round table in the audience, watching the warmly lit stage. No performers, no projected text. Every character is a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, never a flat 2D drawing; mouths closed in small gentle smiles. the man keeps EXACTLY his model-sheet look: black rectangular glasses, short swept black hair, navy cotton overshirt worn open over a white crewneck T-shirt, khaki chinos, white canvas sneakers, black backpack; the woman keeps EXACTLY her model-sheet look: half-up princess-style wavy dark-brown hair with twisted strands at the back, oatmeal knit sweater, sage-green pleated midi skirt, white low sneakers, small tan leather crossbody bag. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text and no logos. No other people. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
